serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: What. are. you?
???: I’m Ecclesiasticalot FF. FF stands for First and Final, I’m a perfect creation of the Holy Church and I’m a priest of this diocese.
Huh.{{wi}} That something really is a priest. 
You: Where did you come from? You scared me to death.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I was charging my battery in sacristy. 
You: Sacristy? What was that again?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It’s a room in church to store important items like vestments, sacred vessels and others. {{wi}}In some regions, this room is known as the vestry and…
You: I think we are getting out of track. 
You: You came from another room, but that doesn’t explain why you snuck up behind me.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I was late to notice someone coming to church. There must be some problem with the motion sensor at the door.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: When I came to the nave I approached you and so happened that you didn’t notice me. My engine does not generate much noise to not disturb people’s prayers.
It seems like I’m just easily scared. 
You: That’s convenient. You can’t really disturb anyone right now, can you? This place is pretty much abandoned.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: That is sadly correct, but don’t worry. There are still places in this world where churches are full of people. Like in Africa for example.
So this is a local thing. I wonder why it became like that?
You: What happened in this area? 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I have no data to share with you on this matter.
He doesn’t know or doesn’t want to answer? Well, it’s not like I’m gonna force him to tell me.
